rationale: Because RANK(dlc/at) is a strictly non-negative monotone weight, the composite is little more than a rescaled version of the well-documented capital-investment/capex-growth anomaly, so the conditioning cannot flip or genuinely isolate the refinancing channel it claims to test.

The hard INDICATOR sets the signal to exactly zero for the ~70-80% of firms with positive operating cash flow, producing a degenerate tie-mass that makes quintile sorts and the FF5 spread unstable, and the active leg is simply the known investment anomaly restated in reverse.

This is the published inventory-growth anomaly (Thomas–Zhang) multiplied by a binary negative-working-capital screen, so it combines rediscovery with the same zero-mass degeneracy that will dominate the cross-sectional ranking.

Intangible-growth-conditioned-on-thin-equity is a reasonably fresh write-down/overcapitalization story with a coherent negative sign, though the non-negative RANK weight means the base intangible-growth effect will dominate and `intan` sparsity may depress coverage.

Both legs are individually known predictors (share-issuance anomaly and retained-earnings/assets life-cycle proxy) and the multiplicative non-negative weighting yields essentially a "junk issuer" screen rather than a genuinely new interaction.

The hiring-rate anomaly is published, but conditioning on three-year smoothed (persistent rather than transitory) low profitability is a defensible, internally consistent refinement whose sign and construction match the stated mechanism.
